## Relationships

### [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/milty-boulter--simon-fletcher.md)

Simon is Milty's uncle, connected through Milty's mother, who is Simon's sister. Their familial bond places Simon in a position of extended family authority and responsibility over his nephew.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)_
